name: Alistair Humphrey
bio:
Alistair's journey into motorsport PR began unconventionally, not through a lifelong passion for racing, but through a fascination with how narratives are shaped and controlled. After graduating with a degree in Communications, he cut his teeth working for a small marketing firm before landing a role with a Formula 3 team. There, he quickly learned the ropes of crisis management, sponsorship acquisition, and media relations.

His approach is built on authenticity and transparency. Alistair believes in crafting compelling stories that resonate with fans and stakeholders alike. He strives to present a human side to the often-glamorous world of racing. His ability to maintain calm under pressure, coupled with his knack for identifying and leveraging unique angles, makes him a valuable asset to any team. He also has a deep understanding of the relationship between PR and team performance.

 What sets Alistair apart is his dedication to fostering genuine relationships with journalists and influencers. He's known for his integrity and his willingness to go the extra mile to ensure that the team's message is heard, and understood, in the right way.

physical.description: Alistair is of average height with a slightly athletic build.
